tools.name: call_yunxiao_api
tools.description: Execute a read-only Yunxiao OpenAPI call. Use this as a fallback for endpoints not covered by dedicated tools. GET is supported; POST is limited to read-only search/list-style endpoints. Prefer dedicated tools (e.g., search_workitems, list_pipelines) when available, as they provide better parameter validation and error guidance.

body.description: JSON string of request body for POST requests.

method.description: HTTP method: GET or POST. Defaults to GET.

path.description: API path relative to the base URL, e.g. /projex/organizations/{orgId}/projects/{projectId}

queryParams.description: JSON string of query parameters to append to the URL.

tools.name: compare

from.description: Source commit SHA, branch, or tag.

organizationId.description: Yunxiao organization ID. When omitted, the server uses the user's default organization.

repositoryId.description: Repository numeric ID or full path such as org/repo.

sourceType.description: Source ref type: branch, tag, or commit.

straight.description: Whether to compare directly without merge base.

targetType.description: Target ref type: branch, tag, or commit.

to.description: Target commit SHA, branch, or tag.
